title: N-doped TiO2 nanocatalyst for one-pot synthesis of α,β-unsaturated esters via the Wittig reaction: a highly efficient and recyclable heterogeneous system
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11294-11305
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09170E, Paper
Open Access

Rohinee D. Hoval, Santosh T. Shinde, Anandrao A. Kale, Nanasaheb S. Gaikwad, Digambar B. Bankar, Nitin M. Thorat, Ramesh B. Gawade, Kaluram G. Kanade, Dinesh P. Amalnerkar
This work reports an N-TiO2 nanoparticle-mediated Wittig reaction enabling stereoselective synthesis of (Z)-alkenes with high yield, simplified work-up, and excellent catalyst recyclability.
